verdict.rationale: Docs confirm each draft/project has its own live preview alongside chat (lovable-docs-34), and that publishing is a separate, explicit step that deploys a snapshot to a public URL (lovable-docs-19, 21) — implying the preview is interactive and pre-publish. Community feedback also references using Lovable's interactive prototype experience before final deployment (lovable-comm-3, lovable-comm-12). missing for 10: explicit documentation describing the live preview pane's real-time update mechanism and independent hands-on verification of interacting with the preview UI itself.
